alert.summary: gateway POST /checkout p95 latency above 400ms for 15s (peak 511ms)

ground_truth.explanation: inventory 2.1.0 replaced one joined query with one query per warehouse (101 round trips per reservation), so reservation latency and span count per trace jump.
